name: microcommerce
description: Your brand's visibility in AI answers: a weekly review, recommendation triage and plain-language reports, through the Microcommerce connector.

interface.longDescription: Connects to your Microcommerce workspace to read and work on your brand's visibility in AI answers: where your current cycle stands, which tracked buyer questions are rising or decaying, who gets cited and recommended instead of you, and what to do next. Includes a weekly review, a walk through open recommendations that records only the decisions you agree to, and plain-language explanations of the reports. Sign in with your Microcommerce admin login; you see only the organizations your membership allows. Some steps, such as starting a cycle or publishing a product description, are done in the Microcommerce admin.
defaultPrompt: Give me this week's review of our visibility in AI answers.
Walk me through our open recommendations.
Explain our prompt report as if I've never seen it.
